reference: User-approved ten wall studies. Generate one flat square material per style; no screenshot crops.

records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square albedo texture for a mobile 3D freshwater aquarium interior wall. Primary request: Charcoal black volcanic basalt cliff, irregular angular chunky rock plates and fine pores, dark cool grays but readable, natural fractures, NOT bricks. Composition: orthographic straight-on FLAT MATERIAL SCAN filling the entire square edge to edge. Seamlessly tileable on BOTH axes; all four edges match with no border, no vignette, no central focal object. Material details at medium scale visible in game. Style: realistic game PBR diffuse color texture, rich carefully restrained natural color, soft ambient occlusion in crevices only. Neutral even diffuse illumination, NO directional cast shadows, NO bright specular highlights, NO water, NO caustics, NO fish, NO plants, NO tank, NO floor, NO perspective, NO writing or labels, NO grid/contact sheet. Output one square texture only, opaque background.
